name: pokemon-project-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Gen 1 Pokémon battle engine, protocol, binding, CLI, and multiplayer server

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@pokemon/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@pokemon/engine-binding && npm run build --workspace=@pokemon/server && npm run build --workspace=@pokemon/client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@pokemon/protocol && npm run test --workspace=@pokemon/engine-binding && npm run test --workspace=@pokemon/server && npm run test --workspace=@pokemon/client
